key_insight: MedGuards uses multiple specialized LLM agents plus confidence-based arbitration to detect and correct medical text errors more reliably without extra model training.
clinical_relevance: It could help make clinical note generation and other healthcare text outputs safer by catching and fixing mistakes that may affect patient safety.
method: Separate agents handle error detection, localization, and correction.
A confidence-guided arbitration step resolves disagreements using reasoning traces and confidence scores.
No additional training of the base LLMs is required.
evidence_signal: The framework was tested across four multilingual medical clinical-note datasets and showed significant improvements on multiple metrics and models, including the new KPCS metric.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of in-context prompting and arbitration, so real-world deployment still needs careful validation on local data and workflows.
paper_title: MedGuards: Multi-Agent System for Reliable Medical Error Detection and Correction
